title: Coding with Letta Code
description: Letta Code on your project with Anthropic's API (your key stays outside the sandbox), PyPI, npm and GitHub open for the project's packages and code, its long-term memory kept in the sandbox (the local backend, never Letta Cloud); everything else stays closed.

de.title: Programmieren mit Letta Code
de.description: Letta Code an Ihrem Projekt mit der API von Anthropic (Ihr Schlüssel bleibt außerhalb der Sandbox), PyPI, npm und GitHub offen für die Pakete und den Code des Projekts, sein Langzeitgedächtnis bleibt in der Sandbox (das lokale Backend, nie Letta Cloud); alles andere bleibt zu.

notes: The model: Anthropic's API with your key (sandbox-ai secrets set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY once). Letta Code sees a placeholder, the connection proxy puts the key in on the wire; --model names the handle (anthropic/...). Another provider: --api-key api.openai.com=OPENAI_API_KEY or openrouter.ai=OPENROUTER_API_KEY with its --model, or a model server of yours with --llm (the preset letta-local-llm).
PyPI, npm and GitHub are open for the project's dependencies; everything else is refused or asked (--ask). Pushes: a login during the run (sandbox-ai net allow --git-token-env ...) or the push proxy.

Memory: Letta Code's own memory (memory blocks, MemFS, conversations) lives in ~/.letta/lc-local-backend of the start's HOME, kept with the start (sandbox-ai resume NAME); ~/.letta/AGENTS.md holds notes about this project and is kept between runs (not with --no-memory).

Letta Code asks before it changes something; -D lets it go on without asking. Letta Cloud, its update check and skills from GitHub, ClawHub and npm stay off unless --letta-enable names them (cloud, updates, skills-install).
Letta Code's telemetry is always off and cannot be turned on (its opt-out variables are set and the proxy refuses its telemetry paths on api.letta.com).
Letta Code is not live-tested yet (a start says so); its image first: sandbox-ai build letta.
